definitions.control: Same executable former per-object source-lease capture vs grouped source admission; product separated architecture and render/worker/commit policies held fixed
definitions.request: Normal BooleanUnion CMD start through options/final submit returning; excludes subsequent UI drawing
definitions.transition: Full callback gap that contains the request, selection and associated UI redraw; not isolated constructor time
definitions.fps: Distinct encoded Perspective frames during steady pointer navigation; not UI callback or RDP client video FPS
definitions.repeats: Two alternating pairs per profile/size; descriptive medians and extrema, no statistical significance claim
definitions.exact_geometry: Identical native output source SHA across all eight runs per scene, native volume/bounds/closedness/solids/naked-edge checks, equal per-profile display density

diagnostic.scope: Interrupted optional debug request/cancel probe, one completed High serial request sample; no completed debug Boolean/FPS test
diagnostic.limitation: Overlapped release compilation; absolute time not accepted as release performance. Stopped owned probe during expensive Light fixture construction; batch half not measured in debug.
